scope: Controlled production-code arenas and stat sweeps; not full-run win rates or player acceptance.

abilities-summary.scope: All legal active ability levels/branches/finals, six regional fixtures, cast and first 2s with three linked disabled spheres and eight high-HP targets. No sustained cooldown/uptime or full run.

ensembles-summary.scope: Seeded level-60 fixtures: 4-8 distinct final spheres plus 3-12 artifacts, capacity-only shop upgrade III, three seeds, assigned region, production-validated open-arc placement, twelve targets, network/Resonance ticked, 10s. No active casts, waves, kill procs, affordability or survival outcome.

regions-summary.scope: Six regions, thirteen isolated roles, stationary and circular-moving player, 30s at 60Hz, real movement/attacks/contact/shots; no waves, bosses, hazards or survival win-rate.

replays-summary.scope: Five suspected strong/weak artifact pairs replayed with/without equipment on the same three seeds, free targets, 20s. Conditional control effects and defensive/economy value must not be ranked by DPS alone.

stats-summary.scope: Analytic production stats, one sphere, no network/active buffs, every singleton and pair for every legal sphere state, plus deterministic larger subsets. NOT combat outcomes.

wounded-summary.scope: Every final sphere branch, one/eight anchored boss-tagged training targets at 10% HP, three seeds, 20s. No boss controller, deaths/kill procs or full-run survival.

summary.scope: Production SimulationTick in isolated 20s arenas at 60Hz: sphere, projectiles, drones, enemies, enemy shots and particles. No waves, input, drops, economy or full-run win-rate.

tuning-isolation.scope: Actual runtime damage, every valid sphere state, campaign-only Pulse tuning and neutral other families/legacy.

visual-isolation.scope: All ten families, first final, all artifacts as a stress fixture, 5s: exact target HP/positions, RNG, attack timer/player HP with normal vs early-retired cosmetic particles. Not a legal balance build.

placement-probe.scope: Every ensemble size, actual placement/path/capacity checks; open 270-degree arc.

triangle-regression.scope: Actual damage pipeline: campaign dense/sparse Triangle pulses terminate, next primary still counts, sparse legacy recursion/cadence unchanged.

sourceNote: Checkout revision at collection time; exact source SHA256 below identifies tested code including any local campaign tuning.

editor.scope: After final production-code arena jobs; Editor tests, not Android performance or full runs

largestImmediateBurst.scope: Fixed eight-target activation fixture; not a sustained-DPS or survival ranking.

ensembleCoverage.scope: Sampled open-arc fixed-target contexts; extrema are not full-run rankings.

triangleReproduction.before: Repeated native fault/hang in first tick, phase sphere Gravity; no completed pre-fix arena.
triangleReproduction.scope: Previously failing production-code fixture; not attribution of historical Android 3:29 freeze.

postTriangleActiveReplay.scope: Same fixed-support activation fixtures replayed after Triangle guard; not the mixed-sphere stress fixtures.

pairedReplays.scope: Same-seed 20s free-target comparison; no kill procs, economy or survival valuation.
